title: pix_opencv_athreshold
description: `pix_opencv_athreshold` performs adaptive thresholding to segment an image, calculating a threshold individually for each pixel and assigning thresholded pixels a configurable maximum value (255 by default). Use the `method` message to select mean-based thresholding (0, the default) or Gaussian-based thresholding (1); inverse mode is off by default.
